Diagnosis.submission: The user-service Kubernetes Service has a misconfigured targetPort. The service exposes port 9090 externally but routes traffic to targetPort 9999 on the container. However, the user-service application actually listens on port 9090. This means all Thrift RPC calls from other services (like compose-post-service) to user-service:9090 get forwarded to container port 9999 where nothing is listening, resulting in "Connection refused" errors. The fix is to change the user-service Service targetPort from 9999 to 9090.
